and_to_or_alu.name: Bitwise AND mutated to OR in the ALU
and_to_or_alu.note: The brief named picorv32_pcpi_fast_mul, but that module contains no bitwise AND; the AND/OR operator mutation lives in the ALU.

fast_mul_decode_and_to_or.name: Logical AND mutated to OR in the picorv32_pcpi_fast_mul instruction decode (literal brief)
fast_mul_decode_and_to_or.note: The only AND operators in picorv32_pcpi_fast_mul are logical (&&). Mutating the decode term is the literal reading of the brief; it is expected to be an equivalent mutant in this configuration because the funct3 case below it still selects only MUL/MULH/MULHSU/MULHU.

fast_mul_rs2_signed_widened.name: Signedness mask widened in picorv32_pcpi_fast_mul (MULHSU treats rs2 as signed)
fast_mul_rs2_signed_widened.note: Observable bit-level operator fault inside picorv32_pcpi_fast_mul: the reduction-OR that selects signed rs2 gains MULHSU.

mem_addr_bit2_stuck.name: Stuck-at-0 on data address bit 2
mem_addr_bit2_stuck.note: Bit 0/1 are already zero (word-aligned address), so a stuck-at there is a no-op; bit 2 is the lowest observable bit. Fetch addresses are left intact.

slt_signed_as_unsigned.name: Signed less-than computed unsigned (subtle, no magic constants)

store_after_store_dropped.name: Second of two back-to-back data stores loses its write strobe
store_after_store_dropped.note: Bus-level back-to-back = a data store completes and no data load intervenes (instruction fetches are ignored). mem_ready itself is a testbench input, so the fault is injected in the core's reaction to it.

store_after_store_dropped_intermittent.name: Intermittent write-strobe drop on back-to-back stores (fires when a free-running 3-bit counter is 0)
store_after_store_dropped_intermittent.note: Closer to the brief's 'intermittent mem_ready handshake drop': the fault depends on cycle timing, so whether a given back-to-back store pair is hit depends on program layout and memory wait states.

stale_latched_branch.name: latched_branch not cleared at instruction launch (uncleared state flag)
stale_latched_branch.note: Substitute for 'uncleaned interrupt trap flags': ENABLE_IRQ=0 in this build and the ISS has no interrupt model, so an IRQ flag fault would be unobservable by construction.
